depends_on: Sum_{n<=N} mu(n)/n -> 0 (von Mangoldt 1897, Landau 1899; PNT-equivalent; not in Mathlib)
notes: Re z > 1: Sum mu(n)/phi(n)^z = 0 unconditionally in Lean (A097945_re_gt_one; Euler product, factor at 2 vanishes). s = 1: partial sums of mu(n)/phi(n) and a(n)/phi(n)^2 tend to 0 (A097945_conditional) from the hypothesis Sum mu(n)/n = 0, via mu/phi = k * (mu/id) with Sum|k| < oo and Tannery. Outside Lean: that hypothesis (PNT-strength, classical).

sources.cite: E. Landau, Neuer Beweis der Gleichung Sum mu(k)/k = 0, Inaugural-Dissertation, Berlin 1899

prior_art.note: Statement not found in print; it follows from Landau's theorem by the standard convolution argument.
